items.reason: This lightweight mattifying gel is made to keep shine in check through the day, which suits your oily-looking skin and your lunchtime shine.
A gentle, fragrance-free-style rinse-off cleanser clears away surface oil without stripping, so the gel sits well on top.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and evening, then smooth on a thin layer of the mattifying gel, adding a little more only where shine shows up first. Nothing else in your cart needed to change, and a daily sunscreen is a good habit if you spend time outdoors.
